title: fix(app-shell): a related list's View all carries the list's own filter, or is not offered
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AHezFqxq2NEBfcwsXbEqsF)_

Fixes #25888

Clause-②: yes (an optional member on the exported `ResolveRelatedRecordActionsInput` of `@object-ui/react` widens its public type surface, additive; the seat owes a TIER_DEFAULT review record before the queue; re-declared if the PR changes no exported type)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong

A `record:related_list` "View all" link opened the child object's list scoped by the list's relationship alone. The list's own `filter` never reached the host that builds the link: the renderer's `resolve` call handed the bridge `objectName`, `relationshipField` and `parentId` only, and the bridge built `recordListPath(appName, objectName, { [relationshipField]: parentId })`. On the card's repro (Approvals on a record page, filter `object_name`, relationship `record_id`) the destination read `filter[record_id]=ID` only, and the approvals request read gate, which admits a record reader only on a read pinning both fields, answered it with the empty participant slice: 2 rows on the tab, 0 on "View all".

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/react`** — `ResolveRelatedRecordActionsInput` gains an optional `filter` (`ViewFilterRule[] | FilterNode`): the list's own scope filter, already resolved. The `onViewAll` doc now says the destination is the relationship AND that filter, and names the cases where the handler is withheld.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`** (`record-related-list.tsx`) — resolves `schema.filter` with `useResolvedFilter(schema.filter, useFilterScope())`, the same hook and scope `RelatedList` uses for its own query at the same place in the tree, and hands that value to `resolve`. Resolving here and not in the bridge is deliberate: the bridge is mounted above the page's `RecordContextProvider`, so its filter scope has no `recordId` and a `{record_id}` token would stay unresolved there while the tab resolved it.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** — new `exactRecordListFilter(sources, canRead)` beside `recordListPath` in `useOpenRecordList.ts`: the AND of the sources as a filter the list route writes EXACTLY, or `null`. The bridge passes `[{ [relationshipField]: parentId }, filter]` and draws "View all" only on a non-null answer.

## The open question, settled: a filter the URL cannot express

Ruling: never let the full list show rows the tab did not. Writing only the expressible subset of an AND is always a wider (or, behind a pinning read gate, a different) list, so there is no safe subset: either every condition is written or the link is withheld. `exactRecordListFilter` writes exactly the route's grammar (equality to a non-empty string or finite number, the four range bounds, `$null` / `$exists` / `$empty` with a boolean, conjunction) and answers `null` for anything else: `$or` and other combinators, `$in`, `$ne`, text operators, a boolean / `null` / `Date` comparand, an empty string (the read side skips an empty param), two different comparands in one param (including a filter that contradicts the relationship), a filter the lowering refuses, and any condition on a field the viewer cannot read (`ObjectDataPage` drops such a condition). Each accepted condition is proved by its own round trip: written alone it must read back through `parseUrlFilterTriples` as exactly one triple. Placeholders (`{current_user_id}`, `{record_id}`, the date macros) are resolved before this point, by the renderer, against the list's own scope.

## Tests

- `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.viewAllFilter-25888.test.tsx` (real bridge + `SchemaRenderer` + `RelatedList`, oracle `parseUrlFilterTriples`): the repro carries both `record_id` and `object_name`; CONTROL with no `filter` carries the relationship alone; a `{current_user_id}` filter is written resolved; range + is-null travel; an `or` filter draws no link; a filter field the viewer cannot read draws no link; CONTROL denying an unrelated field still draws and carries both.
- `exactRecordListFilter-25888.test.ts`: every spelling round-trips, agreeing duplicates collapse, nine inexpressible shapes refuse, `canRead` refuses for the relationship and the filter field (control: an unrelated field), a lowering refusal is `null`, never "no filter".
- `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.viewAll-12741.test.tsx` (existing) stays green.

## Verification (head `a281cecb`, after merging `origin/main`)

- New + existing View all suites: 3 files, 27/27 passed. Ablation: with the bridge's `filter` argument removed (`ablation-replace`, anchor 1 -> 0, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty) the 25888 bridge suite went 6 failed / 1 passed, the one survivor being the no-filter CONTROL.
- Related suites across the three packages (every app-shell test file named for related records / related lists / `useOpenRecordList` / drill / View all, every plugin-detail related-list file, every react file reading `RelatedRecordActions` or `useResolvedFilter`): 73 files, 455/455 passed.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0, after building the app-shell dependency closure on the merged tree.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`, no paths): 46 run, every one exit 0, plus `check-changeset-fixed` exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 46/46 with 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Declared narrowing: the three packages' FULL suites were not run locally (an attempt exceeded the 2-hour background ceiling and was stopped with no reading); CI's `Build & E2E UI` and `Test Core` run them.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is re-recorded (registry source hash only; `check-sdui-manifest` reds on any `ui/packages/**` source edit). It was outside the claim's declared file surface; it is a regenerated artifact, `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, 106 components unchanged.
- A related list whose filter holds a boolean equality (`done = true`) now draws no "View all". The URL carries text, and whether `filter[done]=true` reads back as the list's boolean comparison is unmeasured, so the fail-closed answer is taken. Widening the route's grammar (booleans, `$in`, `$or`) is a separate change to the `/data` URL contract, not this fix.
